SAN FRANCISCO EDITION OF 231.0709
Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Atlanta, City Council defeats attempt to repeal a gay rights clause in city's Bill of Rights 2. Voting underway to change federal prohibitions on rape to be defined as sexual assault on another person, regardless of sex or age, and including spouse-on-spouse assault 3. $111,000 from a benefactor's will to go to Lambda legal defense and education and the Human Rights Fund 4. California gubernatorial candidate Tom Bradley turns toward the gay vote 5. Hollywood stars lend their support to a "No on 64" labor rally 6. Call for public access channel KQED to broadcast more gay-oriented programming 7. AIDS PSA television spots begin airing on San Francisco CBS affiliate 8. Virginia Appuzo named by Governor Cuomo as vice-chair of the New York State AIDS Advisory Council COMMERCIAL: Shanti Project featuring Mikhail Baryshnikov 9. Research for an AIDS vaccine estimated at $1.6 billion 10. Notre Dame University rules against a gay-oriented student committee 11. US Attorney General encourages AIDS education for elementary school children, with reactions from San Franciscans 12. Supreme Court petitioned by the Gay Games to their right to use the word "Olympic" 13. West Hollywood mayoral race is plagued by scandals 14. Interview with Pat Norman, candidate for Supervisor 15. Weekly commentary from Sally Gearhart on Measure M and development of downtown San Francisco 16. News reporter Jane Dornacker dies in helicopter crash during a live broadcast 17. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Announcements COMMERCIAL: Shanti Project, featuring Cynthia Harvey 2. Interview with author and wiccan, Zsuzsanna Budapest 3. Clips from stage show, "The Nightclub of the Living Dead" 4. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby 5. Fundraiser announcement 6. Movie Reviews, Halloween-themed 7. Performance by San Francisco's Gay Men's Chorus' barbershop quartet 8. "Ask Dr Farkle" segment about hitting on lesbians 9. S Diana Bogus reads Edgar Allen Poe's "The Raven" over the closing credits
